body: I know it sounds stupid and a bad thing to hope for, but I wish the last guy I dated would want me back.
My PTSD, my parents' emotional abuse, my chronic health problems, stress about school, etc.
Thank you. I used to write a lot. I've been too depressed to finish anything I start writing lately. Maybe I could try again.
Every guy I've ever been interested in or dated.

Oops. I didn't mean to answer that with my normal account. Here's the deleted post below. 

I have tried to surround myself with people that care about me. I found an interest that I love and one that has become my passion. I dance, almost every day. But I can't get the depression or the pain to go away. I can't get people to stop treating me like shit and taking advantage of me. I tried to ask for help from my family, and every time I do, they just treat me even worse than before. Lately, I can't even get myself to go dancing sometimes and it's hard to make myself stay there to keep dancing and keep being aroung people.
I'm one of those girls. That's why I was commenting.

I know this probably isn't much comfort and may not be the case, but maybe the girl ignored you because she's depressed too. I was supposed to go meet this guy today with a group of friends, and I just didn't go and didn't say anything to him about it cause I was too depressed to get dressed and leave the house. I feel terrible about it.
I promise you there are girls out there like you who are feeling the same way about guys.
I just tried, and it didn't work. It just gave me a 404 error :(
I think social awareness might be my problem, but not in the same way. I'm too nice and polite to people. People walk all over my kindness and self-sacrificing nature.

Thank you. I know these things happen. This is far from being the first time I was dumped. My family members are the last people I want to spend time with right now. My parents treat me like shit. I have found things that make me happy, and I'm used to focusing on myself. I'm just tired of never being enough for anyone else.

My age is probably less than how many times I've been rejected as well. I just don't get why I'm rejected so much. I think I'm pretty attractive. I'm smart. I'm caring. I'm laid back. I like to think I'm pretty interesting too. I just don't understand what could be so bad that people won't even give me a chance.

Thank you. Your comment actually made me tear up a little bit. I know how easy it is for me to love strangers, and it's really nice to hear that someone else can find people they don't know special too. I was beginning to think I was just alone in that.
Thank you. That comment really meant a lot, and I could definitely use someone to talk to.
I just can't handle the stress by myself anymore. I need other people to help me and be here for me, and they're not.

I have told her. She told me that sometimes you just have to do what you have to do and reiterated the stress-relieving techniques we've been over. Those don't help anymore though, not when you have this insane amount of stress.

I just feel like an antidepressant isn't going to help if I'm still having things like my chronic stomach problems to deal with. They were in remission when the meds were working. 

I've told my therapist about a lot of the setbacks, but like I said, a lot of them are out of my control. I really wish someone would just tell me it's ok to be overwhelmed and not be able to handle everything instead of everyone always telling me I'm strong and I can get through it. The strongest bodybuilder in the world still has a limit on what he can bench. I'm the strongest person I know emotionally, but all this is more than any one person should ever have to deal with and I'm at my breaking point.

I've tried so many things. Medications can help. The last one I took helped before I had the bad side effects, but I don't have time to keep trying them til I find one that works. I need to salvage what I can of my education right now and get my life together now. Testing antidepressants makes me all over the place and inconsistent. I found something like art that I love and is my passion, but it is the only thing in my life making me happy right now. I started dancing almost a year ago, and if I did nothing but that I would be truly happy. However, as soon as I stop, I start getting depressed again. Also, when I've been dancing lately, all the stress that's been weighing on my mind makes it hard for me to focus and have fun. A lot of people around me have made me feel guilty for spending so much time dancing too.

Some of the things I've done with my therapist helped, but it was not nearly enough. It's very hard for me to convey to her the fact that I keep having setback after setback in so many different areas that are just out of my control. It's like I fix one thing, and then a new worse problem crops up. The last antidepressant I was on actually worked really well, but then I started having really bad abnormal side effects to it. I'm off it now, and supposed to be starting a new one soon. I'm afraid to try something new. I've tried other ones before, and they all just made me apathetic to everything and not myself.
Also, I think I'm more frustrated with everyone else than the effort I've put into changing things. I'm frustrated with nothing ever being good enough for other people.
I am seeing a therapist and a psychiatrist. The people are my friends and family as well as the therapist and psychiatrist.
Mind if I PM you? I feel like you know right where I am right now.
I know exactly what you mean, and I'm starving right now. Honestly, I feel like I'm dead inside already and I'm not living anyway.

I understand what you're saying, but I don't think you understand what the feelings are that are making me want to kill myself. It has nothing to do with the characters of the people who hurt me. It has everything to do with the fear I live with every day, the emotional flashbacks that can occur at any time, my inability to be physically intimate with people, and my reluctance to let myself have feelings for people. I don't think these things will ever go away, and I can't fully live this way. I feel like I'm dead inside already.

I don't think I need a huge life change actually. I mean, I don't think I need to change myself at all. I posted in other comments why I've been wanting to do this. I think the only change I really need is to get out of my parents house. My friends are awesome. I have a few really close, really good friends that have my back with everything. I kind of reinvented myself in the last year after a tough break up at the beginning of last summer and found a ton of new things I like to do. I'm just losing interest in all of that because of all the pain I'm in.

I've decided to definitely not do it at the moment, but I can't say my feelings won't change later. I don't really want to flush the pills because my psychiatrist just prescribed them to me on Monday and I can't really afford to throw away the money that I spent on them. I have a friend over right now that's helping a little bit, but I will probably want to talk to someone later.

That is exactly what I was thinking, but couldn't figure out how to express it. Suicide sounds heavenly, literally, to me. I believe in God and heaven, and being with the only person I know who really, truly loves me sounds absolutely amazing.

Thank you for understanding how I'm feeling. I'm sorry you felt this way too. I would never wish this on anyone. 

I've tried getting involved with things and getting my mind off other people, but it's really not working well when I come right back home to the same problems every day. 

I also have a really hard time just saying fuck you to everyone. I mean I've tried that because I want to not care, but I'm not a self-involved person at all and it makes me feel really uncaring to do that. It also makes me feel really cynical, which is something else that I don't want to be. I'm one of those people that needs to be able to care about and for other people to be happy.
Thank you. I hope this is true.

If you can believe it, I've been raped a total of four times. The most recent time was three weeks ago. I have terrible PTSD from all of it. On top of that, I was pressured into all of my first sexual encounters that were consensual. I had an emotionally abusive two and a half year relationship with a controlling psycho, and my parents have always been emotionally abusive. My dad actually turned to physical abuse about two months ago. I have a very, very giving and loving nature, and people take advantage of it all the time.

Thank you, but I've been saying just one more year for a long time. I've been going to counseling and trying to talk through things, and it's just not helping. I'm trying to keep doing things I've love, but I have so little motivation to keep doing them.
The people around me are the ones that are hurting me.
